risks.title: Illicit tobacco trade competition
risks.summary: Illicit trade (counterfeiting, diversion, smuggling, non-compliant local products) represents a significant and growing threat. Factors such as high taxation, inflation, lack of law enforcement, and weak border controls push consumers toward cheaper illegal products. This reduces volumes, damages brands, increases operational costs, and exposes BAT to substantial fines for failure to meet anti-diversion obligations.
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Item 3.D, with strong language ("significant and growing threat", "adverse effect"), upward trend due to taxation/inflation/weak enforcement, major weight for the tobacco industry with multiple impacts (volumes, brands, costs, regulation).

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions disrupting operations
risks.summary: BAT's operations are exposed to political instability, wars, terrorism, regime changes, and health crises in its markets. Geopolitical tensions (including those related to climate change: water shortages, floods, diseases) may restrict market access, disrupt supply chains, increase security and tax costs, or reduce sales volumes.
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in Item 3.D with high-intensity language ("unpredictable", "outside of its control"), upward trend (Red Sea conflicts mentioned, climate change as amplifier), direct impact on supply chain and market access.

risks.title: Employee and third-party safety in the workplace
risks.summary: Serious injuries, illnesses, or deaths of employees and third parties during research, manufacturing, distribution, or sale of products may occur. Such events expose BAT to reputational damage, recruitment difficulties, civil/criminal litigation, fines, and harm to health risk reduction goals.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 3.D with strong language ("utmost importance", "serious injuries"), stable but persistent trend, impact on reputation, civil/criminal liability, and sustainability credibility.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT system disruptions
risks.summary: BAT relies on a complex digital ecosystem for manufacturing, distribution, marketing, R&D, and reporting. Cyberattacks, human errors, insider threats, and third-party vendor compromises (cloud, vendors) could disrupt operations, compromise data confidentiality/integrity, lead to regulatory fines, and cause reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk in Item 3.D with alert language ("continuously under attack", "intensify", "AI-powered tools"), upward trend (growing external threats, AI adoption), potentially major impact on operations and sensitive data.

risks.title: Inability to meet demand in New Categories
risks.summary: The New Categories supply chain (e-cigarettes, oral products) is complex, with reliance on single suppliers, product recall risks, regulatory rejection (e.g., Vuse PMTA), ingredient bans (menthol), and exposure of trade secrets to competitors. Overprojections have caused impairments and affect working capital.
risks.score_rationale: Strategic risk in Item 3.D with language of importance ("complex environment", "enhanced risk"), upward trend (Vuse PMTA rejection, menthol bans in California), direct impact on growth and risk reduction goals.

risks.title: Failure of critical financial counterparties
risks.summary: BAT depends on financial counterparties for hedging, insurance, and banking services. Counterparty failure could result in loss of due payments (hedging contracts, insurance) or cash balances, disrupting operations and the ability to pay creditors and suppliers.
risks.score_rationale: Identified risk in Item 3.D but less operational than others, moderate language ("may not be recovered"), stable trend, limited impact to cash and hedging.

risks.title: Raw material price volatility and cost fluctuations
risks.summary: BAT is exposed to volatility in raw material prices (wood pulp, energy, liquid nicotine) and labor costs. Inflation, new tariffs, trade embargoes, market fluctuations, and natural disasters can increase production costs, reduce margins, and affect pricing competitiveness against illicit products.
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk in Item 3.D with impact language ("price volatility", "numerous factors"), upward trend (inflation, tariffs, trade embargoes), significant weight for manufacturing cost structure.

risks.title: Regulatory risks and product restrictions
risks.summary: BAT faces increasing regulation: plain packaging bans, graphic warnings, flavor restrictions, ingredient bans (menthol), display bans, and structural tax increases. These restrictions favor illicit products, increase compliance costs, reduce volumes, and may block access to certain markets or product categories.
risks.score_rationale: Major cross-cutting risk mentioned in forward-looking statements and Item 3.D ("adverse domestic or international legislation", "regulatory restrictions"), upward trend (plain packaging, graphic warnings, flavor bans), existential impact on business model.
